BiblicalUsage: Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, the Bible says, and their cry came up unto God — and Isaiah says the new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, and all the merryhearted do sigh. The word is the sound of a people worn down: not a prayer with words, but a sigh, and God hears it as a cry.
TheologicalSignificance: A sigh is not a doctrine, but it is a prayer all the same: Israel sighed under Pharaoh and God heard, and I believe He still hears the sighs that have no words in them.
